Cascadia Elementary Weekly Newsletter

Important Dates:
- March 6: Picture Day
- March 9: No School - Professional Development
- March 13: Science Fair

From the Principal:
We are excited to announce our upcoming Science Fair! Students have been working hard on their projects.

Lunch Menu Changes:
Starting next week, we will have a new vegetarian option available daily.

Volunteer Opportunities:
We need volunteers for the Science Fair on March 13th. Please sign up at the front office.
